title: Cutaway Indoor Performance Stage
description: One static cutaway indoor performance hall. Four complete unit-scale low-stage modules support a new scene-only continuous thin top cap bridging their existing narrow seams. Whole piano, guitar-with-stand and score stand remain intact on the cap; four whole benches form two audience banks and two rows around a clear central aisle. A scene-only two-level side access stair meets the stage, and rear/left cutaway walls establish indoor enclosure. One scene preset; zero new independent reusable models. No sound, audience animation, stage loading, code, accessibility, ergonomics, building design or safety certification.
